name: Grävenwiesbach (Germany)
description: Hanging banner of blue with narrow yellow stripes near both edges, charged above the centre with the municipal arms of Grävenwiesbach (a black eagle on yellow).
history: Municipal flag of Grävenwiesbach; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Grävenwiesbach arms — black eagle on yellow
